So for left/center alignment, instead of using `.+?` followed by `fill*`, we need a pattern that matches non-space characters (or characters up to the first space).

The fix would be:
- For `<` (left) alignment: change `. +? +*` to `[^ ]+` (match one or more non-space characters)
- For `^` (center) alignment: similar behavior
